verdict.rationale: QuickBooks Online exposes a documented public REST API (V3) with official SDKs (Node.js OAuth client, PHP SDK) and CRUD examples, plus an official MCP server covering 145 tools/29 entity types/11 reports, all clear evidence of a documented public API surface for driving the product programmatically. Missing for 10: a discoverable OpenAPI/swagger spec at standard well-known paths and an llms.txt (both probed and returned 404), which slightly weakens machine-discoverability for AI-native tooling.
